name: PhotoApp sources
description: The Photo app (raster editing): the SwiftUI App scene and views in Sources/PhotoApp, built from SuiteUI's EditorShell: the window and its intents, the top bar, tool rail and canvas, the Adjust | Layers panel (tool options, adjustment sections with the Levels gamma ScrubField and the Curves tone curve over its histogram, the layer list), the export, image size and straighten sheets (the straighten preview turns the canvas picture on the GPU under a grid), the File, Edit, Select, Image, Layer and View menus, the coalescing canvas renderer, the stroke pacer that applies a display frame's drag samples at once, the pen pressure and the Option key read from AppKit for canvas drags, and the ImageIO codec behind PhotoModel's PhotoImageCodec.
